# Arcana Guide

> Arcana Guide (also called Arcana) is a browser-based AI tarot reading app for people using their own physical tarot or playing cards.

Canonical website: https://www.arcanaguide.com/

## Product facts

- Users choose a spread, shuffle and draw their own physical cards, then upload a spread photo or enter the cards by hand.
- Arcana helps identify cards by position and creates reflective interpretations. Users can review and correct AI identification.
- Arcana does not draw random cards or guarantee predictions.
- The free tier includes one reading per day.
- Premium is a lifetime unlock: $10 USD minimum, $20 suggested, pay what you want. Every contribution at or above $10 unlocks the same features. It is not a monthly subscription.
- Premium includes unlimited readings, the journal, advanced spreads, narration, and reading comparisons.
- Hosted AI is available without a user-supplied API key. An optional Gemini key in Settings sends requests directly to Google. AI needs internet access and service availability.
- Classic readings use built-in meanings without an AI connection once the app has loaded; the first visit needs internet access.
- No Arcana account is required. Readings, journal notes, settings, and Premium activation are stored in the user's browser, with journal backup and restore available.
- A separate device or an AI assistant's cloud browser does not automatically receive that browser's journal or Premium activation. There is no dedicated Muse or Dots connector.
- Photos and relevant reading context are sent to the selected AI service when the user requests AI identification or interpretation.
- Arcana provides reflective guidance, not guaranteed predictions or medical, legal, financial, or mental-health advice.

## Public pages

- [Home and web app](https://www.arcanaguide.com/): Product overview, reading workflow, and key answers.
- [Reading guide](https://www.arcanaguide.com/guide.html): How to use a physical deck, photo identification, manual review, and classic readings.
- [Frequently asked questions](https://www.arcanaguide.com/faq.html): Cards, AI setup, free limits, privacy, and browser compatibility.
- [Free and Premium pricing](https://www.arcanaguide.com/pricing.html): Lifetime pricing, features, activation, and purchase terms.
- [Privacy and data](https://www.arcanaguide.com/privacy.html): Browser storage, AI requests, backups, payments, and external services.
